_about: Compositions: named sequences of entries. An entry is an element name, a sub-composition name, or either followed by ' x N'. Sub-compositions (made of elements) are used inside compositions by name; the composer picks each element's starting condition from the previous element's end.

compositions.name: 5 minutes exercise
compositions.notes: Daily exercise (user 2026-10-19): fewer RTT, no circle. The three single elements bridge the states the chain needs: a recapture before each cutoff block (the cutoff starts side by side) and one follower pass before the second block of lead passes (the lead pass starts face to face). 618 beats: 4:18 on Hot Swing (144), 4:52 on Sunday Reflection (127), 5:01 on Slow Your Roll (123).

compositions.name: rock double triple step
compositions.notes: The six-count basic side by side (user 2026-10-18): rock step, left triple step drifting left, right triple step drifting right, and repeat. Four times = 24 beats.

compositions.name: rock triple step facing
compositions.notes: The same six-count from open position with the notes' side-close-side triples (m_closed_basic).

compositions.name: all elements demo
compositions.notes: Every element once, for review. The cutoff ends side by side facing back; two side-by-side triples close the sequence.

sub_compositions.name: RTT
sub_compositions.notes: Rock step, triple step, triple step: the six-count basic (user 2026-10-18). Works from side and from facing.

sub_compositions.name: pass+recapture
sub_compositions.notes: Out to face to face and back to side by side.

sub_compositions.name: pass+circle
sub_compositions.notes: Out with the pass, home with the circle.
